During the course of document verification on 25/02/2026 in r/o Ms./Mr./Mrs. RAJ RANI (Roll No. 248101212000066) for the
post of TGT (Punjabi) (Male/Female)/TGT (Punjabi) (POST CODE 810/24) the following deficiency(s) was being found:

1. NOC required from current employer. You are once again directed to submit reply alongwith the requisite documents within
the stipulated given time period as you are given a final reminder/last opportunity for the purpose of furnishing reply against the
deficiency memo that was issued to you earlier & also directed to submit the required clarification/NOC as mentioned above to
1 D.R. Cell, Establishment-III Branch of Directorate of Education, Delhi failing which your candidature will be cancelled or it is
presumed that you would no longer be interested to join & candidature cancellation proceedings will be initiated without any
correspondence.

You are therefore directed to submit the requisite documents/clarification as mentioned above to , within 15 days from the date of
issue of this letter.
